## Change and reason

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any schema or consumer impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 -B -m unittest discover -v`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Behavior changes include synthetic regression fixtures; workflow changes retain SHA pins and minimum permissions.
- [ ] No credentials, private program details, sensitive target data or scan results are included. Vulnerabilities were reported privately.

Document any checks that could not run. Explain changes to source attribution, restrictions or publication boundaries; do not hand-edit generated catalog snapshots.
